>

>Question of clarification: Does 'target¨Metuselah's' ALWAYS refer
>to the target of the bleed, or can I target any ash-heap with
>this effect to get +1/+2 bleed?

As a Bleed is a (D) action (with a required target outside specific
card text), and Trochomancy is an action modifier only playable during
an action, I would have to assume* that target methuselah refers to
the target of the action**, not a free standing target. If that was
the intent, I would again assume* it would say "any Methuselah".

* Yes, I know assumptions are the mother of all f***ups, but oh well.
** Target of the action at the time. If it were to be bounced after
that, the cards would have already been lost, and the bleed gained.

Morgan Vening
- Accomplice to a lot of f***ups.
